assets.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one transparent RGBA world prop sprite for Chronoforge Echo, a detailed 2D top-down three-quarter pixel-art JRPG.
Primary request: a recognizable ancient land-based signal BEACON tower, clearly a navigational light rather than a computer terminal or a buoy. Single complete isolated object, fully visible with generous transparent margins, centered on a 1024x1024 square.
Subject: a sturdy tall tapered pale weathered stone pedestal with aged copper metal ribs and a large cylindrical lantern chamber near the top. The lantern's broad glass window faces the viewer and slightly right, with an unlit smoked dark amber lens. A small copper cap over the lantern. Small chipped stone foot platform. Restrained trailing moss at the base, no trees. Height about twice width. Clearly readable at 170 game pixels tall.
Style/medium: richly hand-painted pixel-art game sprite; crisp textured pixels and fine material detail, warm coast ruins aesthetic with weathered ivory stone, dark aged bronze/copper, subtle oxidized teal metal accents. Detailed handcrafted high-resolution game prop, not flat vector shapes, not photorealistic, not toy-like.
Camera: slightly elevated 3/4 view, see top surfaces, upright vertical axis, same mild isometric perspective used in overhead JRPG world sprites.
Lighting: soft ambient daytime light on stone and metal; lantern is definitively OFF, glass is dark with no luminous core and no glow. We will switch the lantern on in code later.
Constraints: actual transparent background with alpha, no checkerboard, no opaque backdrop, no ground terrain patch, no water, no scenery, no characters, no text, no UI, no labels, no duplicates, no sheet. One single beacon sprite.
